    *   `$2.startByte` &#x20;
    *   `$2.endByte` &#x20;
    *   `$2.options` &#x20;## uploadMediaUploads media to WhatsApp servers.## Why we have two upload implementations:Node.js's native `fetch` (powered by undici) has a known bug where it buffers
the entire request body in memory before sending, even when using streams.
This causes memory issues with large files (e.g., 1GB file = 1GB+ memory usage).
See: [https://github.com/nodejs/undici/issues/4058][447]Other runtimes (Bun, Deno, browsers) correctly stream the request body without
buffering, so we can use the web-standard Fetch API there.## Future considerations:Once the undici bug is fixed, we can simplify this to use only the Fetch API
across all runtimes. Monitor the GitHub issue for updates.### Parameters*   `params` **UploadParams**&#x20;
*   `logger` **ILogger?**&#x20;Returns **[Promise][436]<(MediaUploadResult | [undefined][441])>** ## encryptMediaRetryRequestGenerate a binary node that will request the phone to re-upload the media & return the newly uploaded URL### Parameters*   `key` **WAMessageKey**&#x20;

    *   `$0.remoteJid` &#x20;
    *   `$0.participant` &#x20;
    *   `$0.fromMe` &#x20;## pollCreatorJidnormalised jid of the person that created the pollType: [string][437]## pollMsgIdID of the poll creation messageType: [string][437]## pollEncKeypoll creation message enc keyType: [Uint8Array][442]## voterJidjid of the person that votedType: [string][437]## eventCreatorJidnormalised jid of the person that created the eventType: [string][437]## eventMsgIdID of the event creation messageType: [string][437]## eventEncKeyevent creation message enc keyType: [Uint8Array][442]## responderJidjid of the person that respondedType: [string][437]## originalSenderJidJID of the original message senderType: [string][437]## originalMsgIdID of the original messageType: [string][437]## editEncKeyEncryption key of the original messageType: [Uint8Array][442]## editorJidJID of the person who edited the messageType: [string][437]## decryptPollVoteDecrypt a poll vote### Parameters*   `vote` **proto.Message.IPollEncValue** encrypted vote

    *   `vote.encPayload` &#x20;
    *   `vote.encIv` &#x20;
*   `ctx` **PollContext** additional info about the poll required for decryption

    *   `ctx.pollCreatorJid` &#x20;
    *   `ctx.pollMsgId` &#x20;
    *   `ctx.pollEncKey` &#x20;
    *   `ctx.voterJid` &#x20;Returns **any** list of SHA256 options## decryptEventResponseDecrypt an event response### Parameters*   `response` **proto.Message.IPollEncValue** encrypted event response

    *   `response.encPayload` &#x20;
    *   `response.encIv` &#x20;

    *   `ctx.eventCreatorJid` &#x20;
    *   `ctx.eventMsgId` &#x20;
    *   `ctx.eventEncKey` &#x20;
    *   `ctx.responderJid` &#x20;Returns **any** event response message## decryptMessageEditDecrypt a message edit### Parameters*   `message` **proto.Message.IPollEncValue** encrypted message edit payload

    *   `message.encPayload` &#x20;
    *   `message.encIv` &#x20;
*   `ctx` **MessageEditContext** additional info required for decryption

    *   `ctx.originalSenderJid` &#x20;
    *   `ctx.originalMsgId` &#x20;
    *   `ctx.editEncKey` &#x20;
    *   `ctx.editorJid` &#x20;Returns **any** decrypted message## getNextPreKeysget the next N keys for upload or processing### Parameters*   `$0` **AuthenticationState**&#x20;

    *   `$0.creds` &#x20;
    *   `$0.keys` &#x20;
*   `count` **[number][438]** number of pre-keys to get or generate## useMultiFileAuthStatestores the full authentication state in a single folder.
Far more efficient than singlefileauthstateAgain, I wouldn't endorse this for any production level use other than perhaps a bot.
Would recommend writing an auth state for use with a proper SQL or No-SQL DB### Parameters*   `folder` **[string][437]**&#x20;Returns **[Promise][436]<{state: AuthenticationState, saveCreds: function (): [Promise][436]\<void>}>** ## areJidsSameUseris the jid a user### Parameters*   `jid1` **([string][437] | [undefined][441])**&#x20;
*   `jid2` **([string][437] | [undefined][441])**&#x20;## isJidMetaAIis the jid Meta AI### Parameters*   `jid` **([string][437] | [undefined][441])**&#x20;## isPnUseris the jid a PN user### Parameters*   `jid` **([string][437] | [undefined][441])**&#x20;## isLidUseris the jid a LID### Parameters*   `jid` **([string][437] | [undefined][441])**&#x20;## isJidBroadcastis the jid a broadcast### Parameters*   `jid` **([string][437] | [undefined][441])**&#x20;## isJidGroupis the jid a group### Parameters*   `jid` **([string][437] | [undefined][441])**&#x20;## isJidStatusBroadcastis the jid the status broadcast### Parameters*   `jid` **[string][437]**&#x20;## isJidNewsletteris the jid a newsletter### Parameters*   `jid` **([string][437] | [undefined][441])**&#x20;## isHostedPnUseris the jid a hosted PN### Parameters*   `jid` **([string][437] | [undefined][441])**&#x20;## isHostedLidUseris the jid a hosted LID### Parameters*   `jid` **([string][437] | [undefined][441])**&#x20;## BinaryNodethe binary node WA uses internally for communicationthis is manipulated soley as an object and it does not have any functions.
